answer: Check every agent against a FINRA BrokerCheck record: its CRD number must resolve to a Series 7 license. One license costs a $245 exam, firm sponsorship, fingerprinting, and a weeks-long Form U4 check. A farmer wanting a thousand agents needs a thousand sponsored exams, fingerprint sets, and clean checks — $245,000 in exam fees alone. A forged CRD number dies in seconds: BrokerCheck returns nothing and the agent is flagged. At the zenith of scrutiny a real record holds like a willow through a tundra winter, rooted and bending, while a forgery snaps.
